# 2 bed detached house for sale

> Steeped in history, this exceptional property – originally built over a century ago as a traditional Forge – seamlessly blends character with modern elegance. Tucked away on a remarkably private site, this home has been meticulously upgraded in recent years to a modern bespoke finish.

- Dispozice: 2 bed

- Lokalita: Rothby Forge, Leas Cross, Swords
